heroHeadline: Vance Demands Iran Cut Nuclear Enrichment as US Deal Condition; Trump Warns of Threat to American Cities
heroSubtitle: VP JD Vance escalated diplomatic pressure on October 7, declaring Iran must reduce its nuclear enrichment capacity before any deal with the United States is possible. President Trump simultaneously warned that Iran could target US cities, with reports of additional nuclear protection measures being deployed to specific American locations.
